evidence_scope: full 2000-session train_explore shared-cohort diagnostic candidate-recall probe; target-cluster folds are diagnostic and not private validation

visible_context.reuse: read-only; never rebuild, copy, hardlink, symlink, mutate, or delete

unique_mechanism.name: DIAGNOSTIC_BROAD_LIMIT_120_TO_320_STABLE_APPEND
unique_mechanism.capture_boundary: dedicated Agent subclass at _apply_p11 entry; production rankings and candidate_rowids are never mutated
unique_mechanism.expanded_route: same query terms, broad FTS expression, BM25 weights/order, strict route, weighted RRF tie key, coverage fields and coverage ordering as frozen R08
route_identity_gates: expanded broad first 120 equals production broad route exactly
strict route is reused byte-for-byte and is never requeried or changed
production final equals the corresponding sealed variable-length C200 exactly
unique_mechanism.c400: sealed ordered C200 followed by expanded R08 candidates not already in C200, preserving expanded order, capped at 400, without padding
unique_mechanism.served_top10: unchanged production C200 first 10 after control P11; expanded candidates are diagnostic only
unchanged: production retrieval, fusion, coverage, P11, small-ranker, question order, session state, and Top10
catalog, context, proxy, labels, folds, evaluator semantics, and all model parameters
unique_mechanism.runtime: target-blind, causal, diagnostic-only, and default off

train_explore_proxy.access: first existence/stat/open/hash only after both closed C400 traces and all target-free resource gates; one same-handle double-hash/fstat read

formal_protocol.preflight: may read only Git, environment, catalog, tracked sources, sealed C200 aggregate, C200 context, and C200 traces; must not stat/open/hash proxy or labels

receipt.creation: prepared real parent, O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_EXCL, canonical pending LF, fsync; any existing state forbids rerun
receipt.post_receipt_failure: catch BaseException and durably replace only through the same descriptor with INVALID_ONE_SHOT_CONSUMED

formal_protocol.worker_phase: two simultaneous fresh offline workers receive only catalog, verified identifier-free context, and one read-only sealed C200 reference trace; each Agent sees only the current message and its own causal state
formal_protocol.pre_target_gates: both workers close Agent/SQLite, publish O_EXCL traces, pass C200 full-prefix, broad-prefix, schema, catalog, exact-repeat, Top10 identity, source and resource gates
formal_protocol.join_phase: only then open the proxy once with same-handle double-hash/fstat for targets/eligibility and read numeric outer_fold then family_index; compute aggregate membership only
formal_protocol.forbidden: no C200 rerun, no context rebuild, no full Agent evaluator, no fit/selection, no protected split, no network, no GPU, no output identifiers or per-session vectors

hard_gates.trace: 20000 canonical ordered records with only c400, ordinal and turn; every C400 is unique catalog identifiers with len(C200)<=len(C400)<=400 and exact full C200 ordered prefix
hard_gates.exact_repeat: two fresh C400 trace bytes, hashes, record counts, ordered arrays, recall aggregates and inflation aggregates are equal; timing/RSS excluded
hard_gates.candidate_retention: old candidate loss and candidate-level hit-to-miss are structurally zero

decision.recall_go: all hard/resource gates pass and C400 recall is strictly above sealed C200 with at least one incremental target cluster
decision.recall_no_go: all hard/resource gates pass and C400 recall equals sealed C200
decision.training_evidence_gate: positive target-uniform recall, at least two outer folds, no candidate loss, exact repeat and all budgets pass
decision.next_stage: record this unique result and continue to local-model inventory plus Frozen embedding E0, then deterministic GLoSS G0; C400 never directly controls Top10
